fixed_before: any support application under these rules; no pair count, rank, condition, information or leverage value was computed under them before adoption
seen_before_adoption: layout-only target metadata from the existing structural JSONL (cardinalities, coordinates, block target sets, transition types) and the earlier 2026-10-03 conditional support report
unchanged_adopted_rules: outputs/config/schedule_support.json#/geometry (translation + positive isotropic scale; delta=min(0.001*m,0.01*d); bijection; strict; complete cliques)
outputs/config/schedule_support.json#/component_support (weights, Helmert basis, condition<100, residual L2>0.10, retained energy>0.10, node share<0.25, strict)
SEARCH_POLICY.yaml session_pairs (same person, same array set, chronological 1-30 / >=180 days, whole-block 64/64 capacity), roles T5/T10/T11 development, T3 not holdable, candidates T2/T6/T7/T8/T9

evidence.provider_supplement: medRxiv 10.1101/2025.07.02.25330310 supplement (Europe PMC PMC12236888), Supplementary Methods 1.5 and 1.5.2: each session divided into blocks of uninterrupted trials for a specific task; candidate blocks were goal-directed movement to explicit targets (radial-8, Fitts, grid) chosen from task metadata and session notes; idiosyncratic and non-target-directed blocks excluded; bin widths at collection 10-100 ms, >20 ms only T2/T3; blocks concatenated per session
evidence.provider_readme: release source/README.md: trials are go periods identified from changes in target positions and/or task-state signals; positions in task coordinates; no target size or task label
evidence.provider_code: nptl-stanford/array-paper@93beb76 metrics/utils.py: participant-specific far-distance thresholds reflect cursor-coordinate scales (0.2: T2,T3,T7,T9,T10,T11; 160: T5,T6; 5.6: T8; 0.4: eight late T5 sessions); no task or target-size handling anywhere in metrics or batch code
evidence.radial8: Simeral 2011 J Neural Eng (PMC3715131): one center and 8 peripheral targets of fixed size in an oval layout (11.5/12.5/13.5 cm vertical/diagonal/horizontal); goals alternate center and pseudo-random peripheral targets, peripheral targets without replacement per cycle of 8; after errors the cursor is moved to the intended target. Gilja 2015 Nat Med (PMC4805425): fixed-size targets alternated between center and one of 8 peripheral locations; two configurations (S3-matched, enlarged targets). Brandman 2018 J Neural Eng (PMC5823702) and Neural Comput (PMC6685768): targets 2.4 cm, radius 12.1 cm, alternating center/peripheral, pseudo-random, timeout moves cursor to target
evidence.radial4: Jarosiewicz 2013 J Neural Eng (PMC3775656): four-target center-out-back task, targets at center, +-13 cm vertical, +-15 cm horizontal, fixed 1.2 cm radius, each target once per random cycle
evidence.grid: Pandarinath 2017 eLife (PMC5319839): workspace divided into a 6x6 grid of equal squares, one randomly prompted target at a time. Brandman 2018: N=25,36,49,64,81 or 100 square targets in a square grid, pseudo-random order; Brandman 2018 Neural Comput: 36-square grid
evidence.fitts_type: Simeral 2011 mFitts1 and Gilja 2015: target size drawn pseudo-randomly from three diameters at pseudo-random positions; Willett 2017 J Neural Eng (PMC5371026): random-location targets with one of three radii
evidence.between_session_parameters: Gilja 2015 (two radial-8 size/distance configurations) and Willett 2017 (PMC5239755: dwell time and other parameters set per session) document between-session task-parameter changes that the release does not record
evidence.coordinate_storage: structural JSONL values are float64 casts of float32 design values (0.35350000858306885=float32(0.3535); 0.0012000000569969416=float32(0.0012); 6.1232342629258393e-17=float32 of the double cos(pi/2) residue); all 729 target matrices are stored <f8 (target-storage census)

P_precision.same_stored_target: Euclidean distance <= 1e-9 * session layout RMS radius (unique-target centroid/RMS as in schedule_support.json)
P_precision.rationale: float32-quantized design values have relative resolution ~6e-8; observed near-duplicate pairs are 7e-18..6.2e-17 (normalized workspaces) or 1.1e-13..2.3e-13 (pixel workspaces) and no within-session pair lies between 1e-15 and 2.4e-4 RMS radii, so any threshold in [1e-12,1e-4] gives the same merges
P_precision.check: report the count of within-session distinct-target pairs in (1e-12,1e-4] RMS radii; nonzero would contradict the assumption

T_template_slots.radial_slot_tolerance: 0.01 * ring radius (median peripheral distance from the fitted center)
T_template_slots.rationale: 1% of the ring radius is about one tenth of the documented radial-8 target radius (2.4 cm diameter at 12.1 cm) and changes any center-to-peripheral direction by <0.6 degrees; observed within-family stored variants are <=0.5% (T11 center x=0.0012 vs 0.0025) or 0.015% (0.3535 vs 0.353553) of the radius, while the next structural scale is >=8% (oval axes) and 76.5% (adjacent radial-8 targets)
T_template_slots.intended_target: stored targets assigned to one slot are one intended target; labels and near-target exclusion still use native stored coordinates

F_family_from_layout_only.inputs: one stored target point per trial, block identity and trial order only; never cursor, success, neural or decoder information
F_family_from_layout_only.placeholder_target: stored point farther than 1.5 x the largest template extent from the fitted radial center, or more than one lattice spacing outside the fitted grid; its trials are non-displayed go periods and are removed as invalid trials, the block is retained
F_family_from_layout_only.radial_8: one center target plus peripheral targets each within 1 degree of a multiple of 45 degrees from the center, at most one intended target per direction, max/min peripheral distance <= 1.25 (covers the documented oval Radial-8, 13.5/11.5=1.17); session union must contain all 8 directions
F_family_from_layout_only.radial_4: same with directions 0/90/180/270 only; session union must contain exactly those 4 directions
F_family_from_layout_only.grid_n: all points on one n x n lattice (n=5..10, documented N=25..100), equal spacing per axis within slot tolerance, session union >= 50% of the n^2 squares; canonical layout is the full lattice
F_family_from_layout_only.fitts_or_random: any other layout with multiple distances in one direction or more distinct targets than a template allows
F_family_from_layout_only.unclassified: anything else (keyboards, radial-6, incomplete radial unions, other lattices)
F_family_from_layout_only.canonical_layout: radial: center = mean of peripheral intended targets, peripheral = mean of their stored variants; grid: full lattice; matched across sessions with the unchanged adopted delta rule

S_size_dependence.residual_assumption: target size is fixed within each radial/grid configuration (documented); between-session configuration changes (documented for T6/T7/T8) are not recoverable and are treated as unobserved session-level task state

B_block_layout.one_intended_layout: every nonempty block of the session maps to the same template instance (radial center and per-direction targets within slot tolerance; grid lattice spacing/offset within slot tolerance)
B_block_layout.check: count blocks missing slots with at least 16 outward radial trials; peripheral targets are presented without replacement per cycle of 8, so such blocks would contradict finite sampling
B_block_layout.multiple_layouts: sessions whose nonempty blocks map to different templates, families or instances are excluded (SEARCH_POLICY exclude_multiple_or_unstable_layouts)
B_block_layout.check_action: added 21:14 UTC after the layout-only classification run (23 flagged blocks: T6 7 blocks missing all four diagonals with 16-58 outward trials; T11 16 blocks missing one direction with 16-38 outward trials) and before any support value: a flagged block is a different layout, so its session counts as a multiple-layout session (excluded in P0; the block is dropped under S7)

X_transitions.edges: consecutive trials within a block after removing placeholder trials
X_transitions.radial_block_consistent: non-permitted edge fraction <= 0.05 (isolated missing or split go periods); otherwise the block is a conflicting transition pattern (random-order radial variants would give ~78% peripheral-to-peripheral edges)
X_transitions.observed_support_differences: subsets of the permitted set are finite sampling, not conflicts

K_capacity.whole_block_two_sides: unchanged: whole trials, two whole-block sides of >=64
K_capacity.packet_coverage_necessary_condition: there exists such a split in which each side's blocks contain every canonical slot (adopted packet_target_coverage rule; necessary only)

R_participant_support.supported: at least one passing both-lag component in some qualified schedule group
R_participant_support.held_out_eligible: a schedule group whose passing components sum to >=6 near and >=6 long pairs
R_participant_support.design_supported: some held-out triple from eligible T2/T6/T7/T8/T9 leaves >=4 supported among the six development participants (T3,T5,T10,T11 plus the two remaining candidates)

sensitivity_plan.S1_exclude_incomplete_blocks: drop blocks that do not contain every canonical slot (task-specified variant for item 2)
sensitivity_plan.S2_strict_slot_tolerance: slot tolerance 0.001 (T11 center variants become different layouts)
sensitivity_plan.S3_narrow_families: only radial_8 and grid_n size-independent (radial_4 excluded)
sensitivity_plan.S4_scale_locked_matching: translation-only cross-session matching in raw units (proxy for unchanged target configuration and size)
sensitivity_plan.S5_placeholder_blocks_excluded: blocks containing placeholder trials are excluded instead of removing those trials
sensitivity_plan.S6_strict_transitions: any non-permitted radial edge makes the block conflicting
sensitivity_plan.S7_session_schedule_combinations: mixed sessions contribute each single-template block set as a separate session-schedule combination instead of being excluded
sensitivity_plan.S9_strict_group_rule: a schedule group supports a participant only if none of its both-lag components fails a gate
sensitivity_plan.precision_threshold_check: 1e-12 and 1e-6 RMS merges reported as counts only (expected identical)
sensitivity_plan.S10_finite_sampling_check_not_applied: finite sampling assumed for every block (check action above not applied); labelled post hoc

interpretation_limits: claims are conditional on these assumptions; no task identity, controller identity or target size is asserted; no role is assigned; no neural, cursor, success, yield or impedance value is read
